title: lathyrus libani
intro: Lathyrus libani, commonly known as the Lebanese pease or Syrian pea, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family Fabaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including being a rich source of antioxidants and having anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus libani are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been reported to exhibit neuroprotective, antimicrobial, and anticancer activities. The plant's health benefits and therapeutic actions make it a valuable subject for further research in the fields of medicine and pharmacology.
